body: P1: deriving global scope from profile alone can broaden an existing PRF-04 recipient that has a non-empty project allowlist. DEC-SPEC-003 permits PRF-04 global but does not make every PRF-04 assignment global. Backfill global only when the profile is global-capable and projects is empty; otherwise preserve project scope, with a regression fixture.
